items.why: The market is rallying out of the post-election slump, with forecasters calling the worst of the sell-off over, so the fear gauge is falling sharply.
Barron's flags AMD as the beneficiary of Nvidia's troubles, with the stock rallying as investors rotate within chips.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Nvidia stock slides after CEO Jensen Huang apologized for an affair, and the board is probing a spying case involving Huang.

market_note: Dow opened 700 points higher and the rally held through late morning.
summary: Stocks rebounded Monday, with the Nasdaq leading as AI names recovered even as Nvidia slid on CEO probe headlines. AMD surged and the VIX dropped sharply as fear eased.
